bio.title: Bio
bio.introduction: Hey there! I'm Adrián Sotés, which is where A S comes from, leading to '¡A ese!' ('Pick that one!'). Why? Because I want you to choose me to work on your projects. I'm a full-stack web developer and a pro at LiveOps and monetization through gamification.
bio.career: I've spent a big part of my career building virtual communities. I have a degree in Audiovisual Communication. My passion for growing in all sorts of creative areas pushed me to learn web programming and development, along with graphic design, community management, sound design, and even modern harmony.
bio.goal: My goal? To understand all the different layers involved in creating a product, idea, or content, and make sure it serves the purpose it was designed for: to execute a business plan, entertainment, customer loyalty, engagement... The possibilities are endless. What's your motivation?
bio.location: Where am I? You'll find me between Madrid, Asturias, and Navarra (Spain).
